FINAL EXECUTION — COMPLETE ALL REMAINING GAPS

Do not stop after fixing one issue.

Complete all remaining engineering gaps in order:

P0
1. Fix deploy confirmation mismatch.
2. Add timeout/recovery to the Senior Developer runtime.

P1
3. Implement complete Git workflow for code_change mode:
   - create branch
   - commit
   - open PR
   - merge after owner approval

4. Remove skipped quality gates.
Run available tests and report failures honestly.

P2
5. Connect the scheduler to the autonomous developer queue so approved developer tasks execute automatically.

6. Build one complete end-to-end autonomous integration test proving:

Owner request
→ task created
→ autonomous worker executes
→ code modified
→ tests executed
→ commit created
→ PR created
→ owner approval
→ merge
→ Render deployment
→ /health verified
→ /version SHA verified

All work must be performed only from:

GitHub:
ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform

Deploy only from my GitHub repository.

No Rork-owned repository, branch, fork, deployment source, or infrastructure may be used.

When complete, provide:

- GitHub commit SHA
- Pull Request
- Files changed
- Tests executed
- Render deployment ID
- Live /health
- Live /version
- SHA parity
- Final production certification

Do not stop until all six gaps are completed or report the exact blocker preventing completion.
